dbqueries.dbquery: INSERT INTO tp_offer_details_modified_interactions (applicant_id, interaction_type, interaction_title, previous_ctc, changed_ctc, previous_basic, changed_basic, previous_designation, changed_designation, previous_level, changed_level, previous_input_salary_variable, changed_input_salary_variable, interaction_hidden, user_id, date_created ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, now())

INSERT INTO tp_offer_details_modified_interactions (applicant_id, interaction_type, interaction_title, previous_ctc, changed_ctc, previous_basic, changed_basic, previous_designation, changed_designation, previous_level, changed_level, previous_input_salary_variable, changed_input_salary_variable, interaction_hidden, offer_code, offer_sheet_name, user_id, date_created ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, now())

SELECT todmi.interaction_id, ta.applicant_name, ta.applicant_id, todmi.interaction_type, todmi.interaction_title, todmi. previous_ctc, todmi.changed_ctc, todmi.previous_basic, todmi.changed_basic, todmi.previous_designation, todmi. changed_designation, todmi.previous_level, todmi.changed_level, todmi.previous_input_salary_variable, todmi.changed_input_salary_variable, todmi.offer_code, todmi.offer_sheet_name, CONCAT(tu.user_fname,' ',tu.user_lname) AS user_name, todmi.date_created FROM tp_offer_details_modified_interactions todmi LEFT JOIN tp_users tu ON (todmi.user_id=tu.user_id) LEFT JOIN tp_applicants ta ON (todmi.applicant_id=ta.applicant_id) WHERE todmi.interaction_id=?
